author.name: Horace Chan
author.headline: Expert in applying AI in verification

text:
Email with a fully AI-native colleague asking for a very specific question feels like calling the tech support hotline, dial 1 for X, dial 2 for Y.

His AI cannot understand exactly what I am asking for, it just keep giving me seemingly helpful looking but useless answers

I should just ask for the path to his Claude Code history jsonl and get my AI to dig up the information myself.

comments.text: Or perhaps your colleague should just answer their own messages? Frankly if I had a colleague that let AI answer their email or chats in such a useless fashion, I would just write them off as useless.
